image_description: A close-up shot of a clear plastic cup containing scoops of ice cream. The primary scoop is light green (possibly pistachio or mint) with visible nut fragments, topped with a generous drizzle of golden-brown caramel sauce. A second scoop, pale yellow or white, is visible beneath. A blue plastic spoon is inserted into the right side of the dessert. The background is a soft, out-of-focus pink.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The caramel sauce has a slightly 'painted' or overly smooth texture in some areas, lacking the fine viscous detail of real syrup. It blends into the ice cream surface with slightly low contrast, suggesting minor generation blur or texture smoothing.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the blue spoon where it enters the ice cream
artifact_observations.reasoning: The entry point of the spoon into the ice cream is somewhat ambiguous. The ice cream does not deform or displace realistically around the spoon's shaft; it appears to merge slightly without clear physical displacement or shadowing, a common AI artifact in object-object interaction.

The elliptical curve of the cup rim is mostly consistent, but the thickness of the plastic rim varies slightly inconsistently along the curve, particularly on the right side near the spoon, suggesting minor geometric warping.
